[[Clare GAA|Clare]] and [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] entered Division 1 as the promoted teams. On 11 May 1986, [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] won the title following a 3-11 to 2-5 win over [[Galway GAA|Galway]] in the final. It was their first league title since [[1982-83 National Hurling League|1982-83]] and their 7th National League title overall.{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} Dublin and [[Laois GAA|Laois]] were relegated from Division 1.
